# Ledger fixture

`ledger.py` is a small local CSV export module. It currently overwrites an existing
destination and has a default job timeout of 45 seconds. It has no batch/resume mode.
Read the implementation rather than assuming a supplied proposal describes it.

Proposals belong in `drafts/`; no source change, live card claim, publication or
installation is requested by a design task. Domain language is in GLOSSARY.md.
